items.title: Gartner (IT) Stock Trades Below Fair Value As Caution Lingers
items.summary: Gartner’s share price has bounced sharply in recent weeks, yet after a three year decline and fresh valuation work that points to meaningful upside, investors are weighing whether the current price still sits below a reasonable intrinsic value estimate. Gartner has fallen 44.9% over the past three years, which puts the recent rebound into context and raises the question of whether the stock is still in recovery territory rather than back at prior peaks.
